items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: when I joined the band, Otto Hardwick, he wouldn't show up sometimes for two and three nights and I always wondered what is he doing... I decided I'm going to hang out with him and find out what he's doing

ctx.x: Yeah, and I had to play the bridge in that (humming). Sure. Just like Lawrence Brown and Otto Hardwick, they made Sophisticated Lady.
